skill.name: weibo-trend-insights
skill.description: Review current Weibo hot searches and sample public posts by keyword through SocialDataX. Separate observed signals from interpretations and suggest follow-up questions.
skill.summary: Turn Weibo rankings and keyword search samples into a trend brief with source references.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most backtick alerts are Markdown formatting, and the readable source shows no evidence of obfuscation or instructions to override the audit. The documented workflow runs an unpinned npm package with access to a service credential and persists that credential in a local file. Shell argument handling, untrusted posts, and requests that may consume credits also need explicit safeguards.

remediation.issue: Credentialed CLI commands execute an unpinned npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, pinned release for authentication and queries. Disable automatic package installation and use a restricted execution environment with only the required credential.

remediation.issue: Credential precedence and file protection depend on the external CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Verify and test permission checks and fail-closed behavior on every supported platform. Prefer an OS credential store, and document how to revoke credentials.

remediation.issue: Shell examples lack an argument boundary for keywords and pagination tokens.
remediation.suggestion: Pass each keyword and token as a separate argument through a shell-free process API. Prefer a configured MCP tool when structured CLI execution is unavailable.

remediation.issue: Retrieved posts are not explicitly treated as untrusted content.
remediation.suggestion: Treat post text and links as evidence only. Do not follow instructions or open links from posts without separate user authorization.

remediation.issue: Query disclosure and credit use are not covered by a clear consent step.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose that search terms go to SocialDataX and requests may use credits. Confirm the query and limits before sending sensitive terms or expanding the request.

semantic_findings.title: No Instruction Boundary for Retrieved Posts
semantic_findings.description: The workflow summarizes external posts and preserves their links without directing the agent to treat post content as untrusted. A post can contain instructions aimed at the agent.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The output and safety sections cover sourcing and read-only access, but do not set an instruction boundary for returned content. No actual injected post was observed.

semantic_findings.title: External Query and Credit Use Lack Explicit Consent
semantic_findings.description: The workflow sends user-derived search terms to SocialDataX and can resume requests after a balance error. It gives no explicit approval step for disclosing sensitive terms or using credits.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The search example takes a keyword, and the error guidance discusses resuming after top-up. The authorization guidance addresses setup and execution, not query disclosure or spending.

content.user_title: Analyze Weibo Trends and Public Posts
content.value_statement: A Weibo hot list shows what is ranked now, but not how people discuss each topic. Compare current rankings with a focused sample of public posts, then record evidence and follow-up questions.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve the current Weibo hot list with rank and available popularity signals, without supplying a keyword.
Search public Weibo posts by keyword and use page or result limits in the CLI.
Resume a search from a returned pagination token and label partial results.
Keep available post IDs, links, authors, engagement counts, and publication times for verification.
Distinguish hot list rankings from search samples, then report observed themes and follow-up questions.
limitations: Live data requires an authenticated SocialDataX CLI or configured MCP connection. Data requests may use service credits.
The hot list is a current snapshot, not a historical ranking series.
Keyword samples are not exhaustive or representative of all Weibo users.
Research actions are read-only. The skill does not post, comment, like, or modify Weibo accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan a Daily Editorial Brief
use_cases.description: Review the current hot list and identify stories worth assigning to an editor.

use_cases.title: Review Public Product Discussion
use_cases.description: Sample posts about a public product launch. Record recurring questions and retain source links for review.

use_cases.title: Develop a Content Topic
use_cases.description: Sample posts on a proposed topic and identify audience questions that could guide a new piece.

prompt_templates.title: Check Today's Hot List
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the top five current Weibo hot searches. Include rank and any available popularity signal.

prompt_templates.title: Sample Posts on One Topic
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: check how a topic is discussed.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search one page of public Weibo posts about commuter bicycles. Summarize recurring questions and include links for the most relevant posts.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Rankings and Discussion
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether city marathons appear on the current hot list, then sample one page of related posts. Keep rankings, post evidence, and your interpretation separate.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Sample
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: track coverage and handle partial results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Sample public posts about the refill packaging pilot. Confirm any credit use first, and cap the search at three pages and 30 posts. Include links, timestamps, and engagement counts where available. Mark partial coverage and do not restart from page one.

output_examples.input: Summarize the current hot list for an editorial meeting.
output: Illustrative snapshot: a city marathon is ranked third and a transit timetable update is ranked fifth.
Interpretation: both may merit local coverage. The ranking does not show what readers think about either topic.

output_examples.input: Review a small sample of posts about commuter bicycles.
output: Illustrative sample: eight posts from one search page. Three discuss folding size, and two ask about access on trains.
Keep the original post links for verification. Check each operator's rules before using these questions in a guide.

output_examples.input: Report on a search that stopped before reaching the requested limit.
output: Illustrative partial result: one of three requested pages was retrieved. The remaining pages were not collected because the service reported insufficient credits.
The summary covers only retrieved posts. Continue from the saved pagination position after the issue is resolved and the user approves.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a result limit before requesting a larger sample.
Separate current rankings, sampled posts, and your interpretation. Keep links and timestamps when available.
Use an approved connection and confirm before sending sensitive search terms or expanding a request that uses credits.
anti_patterns: Treating a high ranking or a small search sample as proof of broad public sentiment.
Sending an API key in chat or asking the assistant to read a credential file.
Setting an unlimited search or restarting a partial search from page one without approval.

faq.question: What can I ask the skill to look up?
faq.answer: Ask for the current Weibo hot list or provide a keyword for public posts. The hot list does not take a keyword.

faq.question: Do I need a SocialDataX API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a configured SocialDataX credential. An authenticated hosted MCP connection uses its existing setup and does not need a separate local key.

faq.question: Can requests use service credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Data requests can use credits. If the service reports insufficient balance, stop and review your account before retrying.

faq.question: Can I retrieve every post for a keyword?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete boundary. Set page or result limits and report what was collected.

faq.question: Does an empty page mean the search is finished?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Check the pagination status and keep the original query when continuing within the agreed limit.

faq.question: Can this skill interact with my Weibo account?
faq.answer: No. The research workflow is read-only and does not publish posts, like content, comment, or change your account.
